purpose: Acknowledged storage-layout changes (#2092): each forbidden change event — an insertion, removal, retype or namespace change in LibVaipakam.Storage or a row struct, or an append inside a footprint-bearing inline struct — keyed by its CONTENT (struct|kind|index|before|after), which a squash merge preserves where a commit id is rewritten. The walker (storage-layout-provenance.mjs --ack) fails CI on any forbidden change NOT listed here. Acknowledging one asserts a --fresh redeploy plan exists for every live chain (CLAUDE.md, the Diamond section). Never hand-add an entry without that plan.
